compile.connector_rule: Interpolate only when support_contact, contact_state, and root_state are identical across adjacent decisive keys. Otherwise hard-cut at the causal join.
compile.method: AUTHORED ASCII KEYS -> EXPLICIT HOLDS/TIMING -> DETERMINISTIC CONNECTIVE MOTION -> ASCII-ONLY FRAME RENDER -> MP4 -> SPA
compile.renderer: Python/Pillow render of generated ASCII frames; ffmpeg libx264 yuv420p

inferred: Guard and hit reaction are modeled as a fork in support authority rather than as small-versus-large versions of the same recoil.
The recovery plant is treated as the first support state capable of servicing the next action; upright torso alone does not complete recovery.
Incoming contact direction is abstracted as right-to-left; exact source hitbox, support foot, chronology, and force magnitude are not claimed.
observed: The complete sheet contains many neutral, travel, attack, defensive-looking compact states, hit/knockdown consequences, floor-level states, and return-to-standing anchors in one corpus.
Compact defensive silhouettes preserve facing/read direction while reducing exposed limb spread and keeping a readable grounded base.
Larger consequence silhouettes change torso axis, root height, support spread, and negative space more aggressively than compact defensive states.

Grounded re-entry silhouettes restore a support-readable base after floor-level or balance-loss states; readability survives exaggeration because torso axis, support footprint, and limb separation remain distinct.
unknown: exact gameplay chronology of sheet cells

principle: A guard can absorb contact while support still owns the root; a true hit reaction begins when support authority breaks, and recovery begins at the first trustworthy plant.

rights.boundary: Whole sheet inspected only to extract general motion principles. No source pixels, palette, costume, face, exact silhouette, sheet layout, tracing, redistribution, or close imitation enter the ASCII rig, video, or SPA.
